components.css: .ds-outline{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:10px;min-height:44px;padding:12px 24px;border-radius:99px;font:600 16px/1.3 DM,Arial,sans-serif;white-space:normal;text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer;transition:background .2s,color .2s;border:1px solid #d8cfd9;background:transparent;color:var(--white)}.ds-outline:hover{background:var(--field)}.ds-primary:focus-visible,.ds-outline:focus-visible,.ds-filter:focus-visible,.ds-nav a:focus-visible,.ds-field input:focus-visible,.ds-news a:focus-visible,.ds-receipt button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--pink);outline-offset:5px}.ds-outline:disabled{opacity:.6;cursor:wait}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-outline{transition:none}}

narrative.overview: Jeolee Cupids uses the established modern pink-and-black fan-hub identity: dark photographic surfaces, prominent Pathway Extreme headings, and DM Sans controls and reading text. Existing photographs and creator attribution are part of that identity. The approved direction preserves this world and does not return to a newspaper/editorial aesthetic.
keyCharacteristics: Rounded photographic cards and pill controls.
Strong display headings with readable sans-serif UI.
Visible sources, creator credits, and dated content.
dos: Do preserve the modern pink-and-black identity and existing photography.
Do use Pathway for display headings and DM for controls and body copy.
Do retain source links, creator credits, and original dates alongside media and updates.
Do retain visible keyboard focus and honor reduced-motion preferences.
donts: Don't replace this identity with a newspaper/editorial aesthetic.
Don't treat an update check time as the story publication time.
Don't replace retained full-size source photographs with optimized derivatives.
Don't claim browser, contrast, or mobile visual verification from this code-only record.
